# YACE19AI

> Research, imagination and world models.

YACE19AI explores world models, scientific AI and open models through research, prototypes and open questions. It is the research and imagination brand in the PRIME-AI Sovereign Constellation.

## Pages
- [Research home](https://yace19ai.com/): Mission, research domains, lab systems and evidence placeholders.
- [Lab systems](https://yace19ai.com/fleet): Selected repositories linked to the research and engineering work.
- [Our approach](https://yace19ai.com/philosophy): Principles for research-led prototyping.
- [Interactive archive](https://yace19ai.com/games): Historical local experiments; not claims of AI execution.
- [Media archive](https://yace19ai.com/media): Recorded demos with archive and QA context.

## Evidence policy
Publication, model and benchmark entries are marked TODO until DOI-linked papers, model cards or reproducible results are available. Repository links indicate public source only, not service availability, production deployment or measured performance.
